name: zoto-botz-skills
description: Consume governed Agent Skills and subagents from the hosted botz.ai MCP server (https://mcp.botz.ai/mcp, OAuth sign-in) with zero-drift version pinning.

interface.longDescription: Connects your agent to the hosted botz.ai MCP server (https://mcp.botz.ai/mcp, OAuth sign-in, no static tokens). The botz-mcp skill locates skills and subagents semantically, downloads them as token-frugal CRUX documents, pins each by permanent guid and version in .botz/skills.lock.json, surfaces evolution updates, and requests new primitives conversationally when nothing fits.
